biotools.summary: Selenoprofiles is a software resource for characterizing and analyzing the vertebrate selenoproteome, focusing on the evolutionary dynamics of selenoproteins across various lineages. It identifies duplications, losses, and conversions related to selenocysteine incorporation, providing insights into selenium biology and biodiversity genomics.
biotools.name: selenoprofiles
